links.comparator_used: Universal AI-FoCUS imaging of all patients (AI-FoCUS for all)
links.outcome: Detection of structural heart disease and FoCUS imaging utilization
links.effect: Two-step strategy (positive AI-ECG then AI-FoCUS) had PPV/NPV 96.1%/95.6% and limited FoCUS imaging to 47% of patients; AI-FoCUS for all had PPV 95.4% and NPV 98.0%.
links.tradeoff: Lower sensitivity than AI-FoCUS for all; NPV fell from 98.0% to 95.6%.
links.quote: A two-step AI-ECG then AI-FoCUS strategy reduced FoCUS utilization, but lowered sensitivity compared with AI-FoCUS for all.

design_hint: two-step screening strategy (AI-ECG triage before AI-guided ultrasound)
